verdict.rationale: The issuing docs include a page for testing verification errors, where you can force one or more verification checks to fail. Cards are issued only after an account holder is created. Together these imply a platform-run verification step tied to issuance, but the evidence is a single thin mention. Missing for 10: explicit KYC vs. KYB flows, documented data requirements per entity type, review/verification status states, re-verification flows, and independent corroboration.
